title: Effects of tapering on performance in endurance athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis (PLOS ONE, 2023)
claims: The review included 14 studies and found significant improvements in time-trial and time-to-exhaustion performance after tapering.
A taper reducing training volume by 41-60%, maintaining intensity and frequency, and lasting up to 21 days was associated with improved time-trial performance.
Recovery and the optimal taper duration vary between individuals, so tapering should be adapted to the runner rather than copied rigidly.
